description.zh:
迁移任务的业务状态。取值范围：

- Preparing：准备中。
- Syncing：同步中。
- Processing：处理中。
- Cleaning：清理中。
description.en:
The business status of the migration task. Valid values:

- Preparing: The task is being prepared.

- Syncing: Data is being synchronized.

- Processing: The task is being processed.

- Cleaning: The task is being cleared.

description.zh: 迁移任务ID列表。N的最大值：50。
description.en: The IDs of the migration tasks. You can specify up to 50 migration task IDs.

description.zh:
迁移任务的类型。取值范围：

- 0：服务器迁移。
- 1：操作系统迁移。
- 2：跨可用区迁移。
- 3：VMware无代理迁移。
description.en:
The type of the migration task. Valid values:

- 0: server migration.

- 1: operating system migration.

- 2: cross-zone migration.

- 3: agentless VMware migration.
The name of the migration task.

description.zh:
返回结果中，迁移任务列表的页码。起始值：1。

默认值：1。
description.en:
The page number of the migration task list. The value starts from 1.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

description.zh:
迁移源需迁入的目标阿里云地域ID。

例如，您需要迁移源服务器至杭州，则RegionId为`cn-hangzhou`。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en:
The ID of the destination Alibaba Cloud region to which you want to migrate the source.

For example, if you want to migrate a source server to the China (Hangzhou) region, set RegionId to `cn-hangzhou`. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 迁移源ID列表。N的最大值为50。
description.en: The IDs of the migration sources. You can specify up to 50 migration source IDs.

description.zh:
迁移任务的主状态。取值范围：

- Ready：未开始。
- Running：运行中。
- Stopped：已暂停。
- InError：出错。
- Finished：已完成。
- Waiting：等待中。
- Expired：已过期。
- Deleting：删除中。
description.en:
The main status of the migration task. Valid values:

- Ready: The task is not started.

- Running: The task is running.

- Stopped: The task is paused.

- InError: An error occurred.

- Finished: The task is complete.

- Waiting: The task is waiting.

- Expired: The task has expired.

- Deleting: The task is being deleted.
The tags of the SMC resource.

description.zh:
为SMC资源指定的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能包含http:\//或者https:\//。
description.en:
The key of tag N that is specified for the SMC resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

This parameter can be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

description.zh:
为SMC资源指定的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en:
The value of tag N that is specified for the SMC resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

This parameter can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

title.zh: 查询一个或多个迁移任务的详细信息

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

- 请求参数的作用类似于一个过滤器，过滤器为逻辑与（AND）关系。如果某一参数为空，则过滤器不起作用。
- 支持迁移源的迁移目标为Docker容器镜像，实现低成本容器化应用迁移。关于Docker容器镜像详情请参见[容器镜像服务](~~60744~~)。
descriptions.en:
## API Operations

- Request parameters are used as filters and are combined using a logical AND. If you do not specify a parameter, the corresponding filter is not applied.

- You can migrate a source to a Docker container image for low-cost application containerization. For more information about Docker container images, see [Container Registry](~~60744~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc describe-replication-jobs --name testMigrationTaskName --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --status Ready --business-status Preparing --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --source-id s-bp1bjhkwk2j5hlbn0000 --job-id j-bp1h3d33mekxwu0n0000 --job-type 0 --instance-id i-bp1f1dvfto1sigz50000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmw3ty5y70000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc DescribeReplicationJobs --region cn-hangzhou --Status Ready --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmw3ty5y70000' --JobId.1 'j-bp1h3d33mekxwu0n0000' --BusinessStatus Preparing --Name testMigrationTaskName --JobType 0 --SourceId.1 's-bp1bjhkwk2j5hlbn0000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceId.1 'i-bp1f1dvfto1sigz50000'
